sourceLines.code:
from collections import defaultdict
from itertools import combinations

MAXVAL = 10000000
n, m = map(int, input().split())
price = list(map(int, input().split()))
match = defaultdict(list)
minPrice = MAXVAL

for _ in range(m):
    i, j = map(int, input().split())
    match[i].append(j)
    match[j].append(i)

match = sorted(match.items(), key=lambda x: len(x[1]), reverse=True)
for i, item in enumerate(match):
    if len(item[1]) < 2:
        break
    for temp in combinations(item[1], 2):
        j, k = temp
        if k not in match[j-1][1]:
            continue
        minPrice = min(minPrice, price[i] + price[j-1] + price[k-1])

if minPrice == MAXVAL:
    print(-1)
else:
    print(minPrice)

n,m=[int(i) for i in input().split()]
price=[int(i) for i in input().split()]
from collections import defaultdict
graph=defaultdict(list)
for i in range(m):
    p,c=[int(i) for i in input().split()]
    graph[p].append(c)
    graph[c].append(p)
visited=[0]*(n+1)
pushed=[0]*(n+1)
minn=[]

def bfs(p):
    stack=[]
    stack.append(p)
    while stack:
        start=stack.pop(0)
        visited[start]=1
        for j in graph[start]:
            if not visited[j]:
                visited[j]=1
                stack.append(j)
                pushed[j]=start
            else:
                if pushed[j]==pushed[start]:
                    minn.append(price[j-1]+price[start-1]+price[pushed[j]-1])

bfs(1)
print(pushed)
if not minn:
    print(-1)
else:
    print(min(minn))
